summary: The feature is implemented, but I have not run any tests, as instructed, so the code and test changes are verified only by reading. Changes: rich/progress.py adds TimeElapsedColumn (between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn), a finished_time field on Task, a finished property based on finished_time, capture logic at the end of Progress.update and Progress.advance, and clearing in Task._reset and Progress.reset. rich/default_styles.py adds progress.elapsed (yellow). rich/palette.py adds Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and a TYPE_CHECKING Table import; I chose the header names index, RGB, Color. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased/Added entry. New tests/test_palette.py has test_rich_cast. tests/test_progress.py gets test_time_elapsed_column and an updated test_columns (column added after TimeRemainingColumn; expected output rewritten by hand-tracing the mock clock: elapsed cells, bar widths 33→25 and 23→16, and foo/bar speed cells now read 1 byte/s). Nothing was committed. Open risk: the test_columns expected string is hand-derived and unverified by execution; if it fails, compare actual clock-read order against the trace. test_render, test_track, and test_progress_track are expected to be unaffected but also need a run to confirm.
